Ultimate Anti-Ageing Facial

About

A skin clinic on Swan Street

Shine Skin and Body is a skin clinic at 323 Swan Street, Richmond. The treatment menu centres on extraction facials, dermal needling, SQT Bio-Needling, RF facials, IPL and LED light therapy, alongside the Dermaviduals skincare range.

The clinic is rated 4.8 out of 5 from 155 ratings, as published on its own site (platform not stated).

Questions

Before you book

What treatments do you offer?

Extraction / Skin Foundations facials, dermal needling, SQT Bio-Needling, RF facials, IPL, Redness Relief IPL, the Ultimate Anti-Ageing Facial (IPL plus fractionated laser, face, neck and décolletage), LED light therapy, and the Dermaviduals skincare range.

How much do treatments cost?

Published prices: dermal needling $385, SQT Bio-Needling $385, RF facials from $250, IPL $340, Redness Relief IPL $160. Prices for the extraction facial, the Ultimate Anti-Ageing Facial, LED light therapy and the Dermaviduals range are not published.

Where is the clinic?

323 Swan Street, Richmond VIC 3121. Phone 0431 430 490.

When are you open?

Tuesday 11am–8pm, Wednesday 12pm–8.30pm, Thursday 11am–8.30pm, Friday 10am–4.30pm, Saturday 9am–5pm. Closed Monday and Sunday.

How do I book?

Use the booking form below — it opens your own email app with your request addressed to the clinic. Nothing is stored on this page.
